decisions.reason: Replacing two proposal tables does not alter the narrative packaging or fixed section-order requirements; the table change is fully owned by the source Requirement.
The replacement occurs within the existing full-document layout obligation and does not change its layout pass count, coverage, input stage, or section order.
The source changes tables only and does not change photo integration or the required photo selection.
Replacing proposal tables does not change the required PDF format, file count, email submission method, or export quality.
The supplied replacement tables do not change the Agua Arc brand identity or available brand assets.
The table replacement contains no decision about hyperlinks or their behavior in the saved final file.
The source does not alter Canva delivery, edit access, ownership, asset policy, or reuse rights.
Although revised tables could incidentally affect pagination, the client does not change the page-limit goal, anticipated count, or notification obligation.
The source concerns the separate GreenLatinos RFQ proposal and has no effect on the TPEC proposal-design Requirement.
Requesting replacement of two tables does not explicitly change the agreed count of consolidated revision rounds.
The client acknowledges possible inconvenience but does not change any draft, revision, submission, or deadline date.
